help.anthropic: You'll find it on the keys page of your Anthropic account.

sites.title: Connected sites
sites.titleHelpLabel: How Faro connects to your site
sites.titleTooltip: Faro reads your site with a plugin. We never ask for your password.

emptyState.title: Connect your WordPress site
emptyState.description: Faro will read your pages, posts and products to help you attract more customers. We never ask for your password.

toast.remoteNotNotified: We removed {{name}} from Faro, but we couldn't notify your site. To finish, go to WordPress → Settings → Faro and click Disconnect.

connect.title: Connect your site
connect.passwordNote: We'll never ask for your WordPress password.

step1.title: Install the Faro plugin on your site
step1.downloaded: We saved {{fileName}} to your Downloads folder.
step1.instruction1: Go to your site's WordPress dashboard.
step1.instruction2: Go to Plugins → Add New Plugin → Upload Plugin.
step1.instruction3: Choose faro-wordpress.zip, click Install Now and then Activate.
step1.alreadyInstalled: I already have the plugin installed

step2.title: Create a code in WordPress
step2.description: In WordPress, go to Settings → Faro and click Generate connection code. The code lasts 10 minutes and only works once.

step3.title: Enter the address and the code
step3.urlHelp: The same address your customers type.
step3.codeHelp: It's 6 digits. You can type them with or without a space.
step3.slowNote: It can take up to a minute.
